blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — For the fourth consecutive time, the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) launched a voluntary purchase program to stabilize sugar prices and manage supply during peak production season. The SRA issued Sugar Order (SO) No. 2 for crop year 2026 to 2027 governing the voluntary purchase of raw sugar from local farmers in exchange for […]...
